identity.name: Orchid Eclipse
identity.summary: A broad purple orchid surrounding a dark green seed core.
identity.description: Costs 4 mana per activation. Deals 10 magical damage per affordable activation. Applies 9 poison through the existing combat keyword rules per affordable activation.
identity.lore: The greenhouse grew silent when the first flower opened.

effects.description: Costs 4 mana per activation. Deals 10 magical damage per affordable activation. Applies 9 poison through the existing combat keyword rules per affordable activation.
effects.condition: Equipped; class restriction satisfied; all activation costs can be paid together.

synergies.description: Its venom trace participates in the Elementalist's existing reaction system; arrange it with spells of another element. No extra reaction beyond the shared rules is added.

conditions: All ingredients are packed, unlocked, nonpermanent and form one orthogonally connected group.
recipes.failureBehavior: Incomplete, disconnected or locked inputs consume nothing. A complete recipe always consumes its inputs; an output that cannot fit enters the stash.
recipes.description: Combine Foxglove Formula, Mercy Needlecase, Viper's Proposition into Orchid Eclipse.
